excerpts.text:
1: """Base classes and types for persistent key-value stores.
2: 
3: Stores provide long-term memory that persists across threads and conversations.
4: Supports hierarchical namespaces, key-value storage, and optional vector search.
5: 
6: Core types:
7:     - `BaseStore`: Store interface with sync/async operations
8:     - `Item`: Stored key-value pairs with metadata
9:     - `Op`: Get/Put/Search/List operations
10: """
11: 
12: from __future__ import annotations

708: class BaseStore(ABC):
709:     """Abstract base class for persistent key-value stores.
710: 
711:     Stores enable persistence and memory that can be shared across threads,
712:     scoped to user IDs, assistant IDs, or other arbitrary namespaces.
713:     Some implementations may support semantic search capabilities through
714:     an optional `index` configuration.
715: 
716:     Note:
717:         Semantic search capabilities vary by implementation and are typically
718:         disabled by default. Stores that support this feature can be configured
719:         by providing an `index` configuration at creation time. Without this
720:         configuration, semantic search is disabled and any `index` arguments
721:         to storage operations will have no effect.
722: 
723:         Similarly, TTL (time-to-live) support is disabled by default.
724:         Subclasses must explicitly set `supports_ttl = True` to enable this feature.
725:     """

728:     ttl_config: TTLConfig | None = None
